This is a blog about the beautiful game of baseball and the numbers behind it. I'm Joey, a freshman at Northwestern studying math, and I'm starting this to get some more practice working with real baseball data and to write about anything interesting I find.

The code for everything I write will be on [GitHub](https://github.com/JoeyZeee), so you can check my work.

More to come soon, so stay tuned.
